claim: Patchline ships a staged-rollout controller promoting agent changes only after canary gates pass. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the staged rollout claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make staged-rollout-controller-gate`.
